title: New Moon in Leo
tldr: A seed point for creative fire, visibility, joy, play, leadership, and the right to be seen.
theme: Leo is a fixed fire sign ruled traditionally by Sun. This New Moon begins work around creative fire, visibility, joy, play, leadership, and the right to be seen.
shadow: needing applause to feel worthy, or editing your radiance to stay acceptable
integration: letting yourself shine in a way that gives others permission to shine too

twoWeekArc.teaching: Your people want the real version, not the polished version built for approval.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Begin with Leo; watch what the Aquarius Full Moon reveals about balance, response, and integration.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Track this intention for six months, then revisit what matured at the same-sign Full Moon.

ritual.timing: Set intentions only after the exact New Moon. The strongest window is the first 8 hours; use up to about 60 hours after exact when needed. Do not use this protocol for eclipses.
ritual.materials: Sun kamea, gold or yellow candle, garnet, bay leaf, salt, feather, and water.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what you are calling in through Leo. Choose one small action that proves the intention has a place to land.

journalPrompt: Where am I ready to begin again through creative fire, visibility, joy, play, leadership, and the right to be seen, without repeating the shadow of needing applause to feel worthy, or editing your radiance to stay acceptable?
tarotPrompt: What first action will help this Leo intention take form?
